stem.text: The diagram represents the pattern of stationary waves formed by the superposition of sound waves from a loudspeaker and their reflection from a metal sheet (not shown).

stem.alt: Loudspeaker drawn on the left facing right, followed by a horizontal dashed line with a row of stationary-wave loops drawn along it. Four points on the line are labelled W, X, Y and Z.

stem.text: W, X, Y and Z are four points on the line through the centre of these waves.
Which statement about these stationary waves is correct?

A.text: An antinode is formed at the surface of the metal sheet.

B.text: A node is a quarter of a wavelength from an adjacent antinode.

C.text: The oscillations at X are in phase with those at Y.

D.text: The air particles oscillate perpendicular to the line WZ.
